import { Roles } from "@/types/globals";

export default function UsersPage() {
  const [users, setUsers] = useState<AdminUser[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState("");
  const [currentPage, setCurrentPage] = useState(1);
  const [totalCount, setTotalCount] = useState(0);
  const [hasNextPage, setHasNextPage] = useState(false);
  const [hasPreviousPage, setHasPreviousPage] = useState(false);
  const [statistics, setStatistics] = useState<any>(null);
  const [message, setMessage] = useState<{ type: 'success' | 'error', text: string } | null>(null);

  const pageSize = 10;

  const loadUsers = async (page: number = 1) => {
    try {
      setLoading(true);
      const result = await getUsers(page, pageSize);
      setUsers(result.users);
      setTotalCount(result.totalCount);
      setHasNextPage(result.hasNextPage);
      setHasPreviousPage(result.hasPreviousPage);
      setCurrentPage(page);
    } catch (error) {
      setMessage({ type: 'error', text: 'Failed to load users' });
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const loadStatistics = async () => {
    try {
      const stats = await getUserStatistics();
      setStatistics(stats);
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Failed to load statistics:', error);
    }
  };

  const handleSearch = async () => {
    if (!searchQuery.trim()) {
      loadUsers(1);
      return;
    }

    try {
      setLoading(true);
      const result = await searchUsers(searchQuery, pageSize);
      setUsers(result.users);
      setTotalCount(result.totalCount);
      setHasNextPage(false);
      setHasPreviousPage(false);
      setCurrentPage(1);
    } catch (error) {
      setMessage({ type: 'error', text: 'Failed to search users' });
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleRoleChange = async (userId: string, newRole: Roles) => {
    try {
      const result = await updateUserRole(userId, newRole);
      if (result.success) {
        setMessage({ type: 'success', text: result.message });
        // Update the user in the local state
        setUsers(users.map(user =>
          user.id === userId ? { ...user, role: newRole } : user
        ));
        loadStatistics(); // Refresh stats
      } else {
        setMessage({ type: 'error', text: result.message });
      }
    } catch (error) {
      setMessage({ type: 'error', text: 'Failed to update user role' });
    }
  };

  const handleBanToggle = async (userId: string, currentBanned: boolean) => {
    try {
      const result = await toggleUserBan(userId, !currentBanned);
      if (result.success) {
        setMessage({ type: 'success', text: result.message });
        // Update the user in the local state
        setUsers(users.map(user =>
          user.id === userId ? { ...user, banned: !currentBanned } : user
        ));
        loadStatistics(); // Refresh stats
      } else {
        setMessage({ type: 'error', text: result.message });
      }
    } catch (error) {
      setMessage({ type: 'error', text: 'Failed to update user status' });
    }
  };

  const handleDelete = async (userId: string) => {
    try {
      const result = await deleteUser(userId);
      if (result.success) {
        setMessage({ type: 'success', text: result.message });
        // Remove the user from local state
        setUsers(users.filter(user => user.id !== userId));
        setTotalCount(totalCount - 1);
        loadStatistics(); // Refresh stats
      } else {
        setMessage({ type: 'error', text: result.message });
      }
    } catch (error) {
      setMessage({ type: 'error', text: 'Failed to delete user' });
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    loadUsers();
    loadStatistics();
  }, []);

  // Auto-hide messages after 5 seconds
  useEffect(() => {
    if (message) {
      const timer = setTimeout(() => setMessage(null), 5000);
      return () => clearTimeout(timer);
    }
  }, [message]);

  const formatDate = (timestamp: number) => {
    return new Date(timestamp).toLocaleDateString('en-US', {
      year: 'numeric',
      month: 'short',
      day: 'numeric',
      hour: '2-digit',
      minute: '2-digit'
    });
  };

  const getRoleBadgeVariant = (role: Roles | null) => {
    switch (role) {
      case 'admin': return 'destructive';
      case 'user': return 'secondary';
      default: return 'outline';
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="container mx-auto p-6 space-y-6">
      <div className="flex justify-between items-center">
        <h1 className="text-3xl font-bold">User Management</h1>
      </div>

      {/* Statistics Cards */}
      {statistics && (
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-5 gap-4">
          <Card>
            <CardHeader className="pb-2">
              <CardTitle className="text-sm">Total Users</CardTitle>
            </CardHeader>
            <CardContent>
              <div className="text-2xl font-bold">{statistics.totalUsers}</div>
            </CardContent>
          </Card>
          <Card>
            <CardHeader className="pb-2">
              <CardTitle className="text-sm">Active This Week</CardTitle>
            </CardHeader>
            <CardContent>
              <div className="text-2xl font-bold">{statistics.activeThisWeek}</div>
            </CardContent>
          </Card>
          <Card>
            <CardHeader className="pb-2">
              <CardTitle className="text-sm">New This Month</CardTitle>
            </CardHeader>
            <CardContent>
              <div className="text-2xl font-bold">{statistics.newThisMonth}</div>
            </CardContent>
          </Card>
          <Card>
            <CardHeader className="pb-2">
              <CardTitle className="text-sm">Admin Users</CardTitle>
            </CardHeader>
            <CardContent>
              <div className="text-2xl font-bold">{statistics.adminUsers}</div>
            </CardContent>
          </Card>
          <Card>
            <CardHeader className="pb-2">
              <CardTitle className="text-sm">Banned Users</CardTitle>
            </CardHeader>
            <CardContent>
              <div className="text-2xl font-bold">{statistics.bannedUsers}</div>
            </CardContent>
          </Card>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Message Alert */}
      {message && (
        <Alert variant={message.type === 'error' ? 'destructive' : 'default'}>
          <AlertDescription>{message.text}</AlertDescription>
        </Alert>
      )}

      {/* Search and Controls */}
      <Card>
        <CardHeader>
          <CardTitle>Search Users</CardTitle>
        </CardHeader>
        <CardContent>
          <div className="flex gap-4">
            <Input
              placeholder="Search by email or name..."
              value={searchQuery}
              onChange={(e) => setSearchQuery(e.target.value)}
              onKeyDown={(e) => e.key === 'Enter' && handleSearch()}
            />
            <Button onClick={handleSearch}>Search</Button>
            <Button variant="outline" onClick={() => {
              setSearchQuery('');
              loadUsers(1);
            }}>
              Clear
            </Button>
          </div>
        </CardContent>
      </Card>

      {/* Users Table */}
      <Card>
        <CardHeader>
          <CardTitle>Users ({totalCount})</CardTitle>
        </CardHeader>
        <CardContent>
          {loading ? (
            <div className="text-center py-8">Loading users...</div>
          ) : (
            <>
              <Table>
                <TableHeader>
                  <TableRow>
                    <TableHead>User</TableHead>
                    <TableHead>Email</TableHead>
                    <TableHead>Role</TableHead>
                    <TableHead>Status</TableHead>
                    <TableHead>Created</TableHead>
                    <TableHead>Last Sign In</TableHead>
                    <TableHead>Actions</TableHead>
                  </TableRow>
                </TableHeader>
                <TableBody>
                  {users.map((user) => (
                    <TableRow key={user.id}>
                      <TableCell>
                        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                          <img
                            src={user.imageUrl}
                            alt={`${user.firstName || ''} ${user.lastName || ''}`}
                            className="w-8 h-8 rounded-full"
                          />
                          <span>{user.firstName} {user.lastName}</span>
                        </div>
                      </TableCell>
                      <TableCell>{user.email}</TableCell>
                      <TableCell>
                        <Select
                          value={user.role || 'user'}
                          onValueChange={(value) => handleRoleChange(user.id, value as Roles)}
                        >
                          <SelectTrigger className="w-24">
                            <SelectValue />
                          </SelectTrigger>
                          <SelectContent>
                            <SelectItem value="user">User</SelectItem>
                            <SelectItem value="admin">Admin</SelectItem>
                          </SelectContent>
                        </Select>
                      </TableCell>
                      <TableCell>
                        <Badge variant={user.banned ? 'destructive' : 'secondary'}>
                          {user.banned ? 'Banned' : 'Active'}
                        </Badge>
                      </TableCell>
                      <TableCell>{formatDate(user.createdAt)}</TableCell>
                      <TableCell>
                        {user.lastSignInAt ? formatDate(user.lastSignInAt) : 'Never'}
                      </TableCell>
                      <TableCell>
                        <div className="flex gap-2">
                          <Button
                            size="sm"
                            variant={user.banned ? "outline" : "destructive"}
                            onClick={() => handleBanToggle(user.id, user.banned)}
                          >
                            {user.banned ? 'Unban' : 'Ban'}
                          </Button>
                          <Dialog>
                            <DialogTrigger asChild>
                              <Button size="sm" variant="destructive">Delete</Button>
                            </DialogTrigger>
                            <DialogContent>
                              <DialogHeader>
                                <DialogTitle>Delete User</DialogTitle>
                                <DialogDescription>
                                  Are you sure you want to delete {user.firstName} {user.lastName}? This action cannot be undone.
                                </DialogDescription>
                              </DialogHeader>
                              <DialogFooter>
                                <Button variant="outline">Cancel</Button>
                                <Button variant="destructive" onClick={() => handleDelete(user.id)}>
                                  Delete
                                </Button>
                              </DialogFooter>
                            </DialogContent>
                          </Dialog>
                        </div>
                      </TableCell>
                    </TableRow>
                  ))}
                </TableBody>
              </Table>

              {/* Pagination */}
              <div className="flex justify-between items-center mt-4">
                <div className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                  Showing {users.length} of {totalCount} users
                </div>
                <div className="flex gap-2">
                  <Button
                    variant="outline"
                    onClick={() => loadUsers(currentPage - 1)}
                    disabled={!hasPreviousPage}
                  >
                    Previous
                  </Button>
                  <Button
                    variant="outline"
                    onClick={() => loadUsers(currentPage + 1)}
                    disabled={!hasNextPage}
                  >
                    Next
                  </Button>
                </div>
              </div>
            </>
          )}
        </CardContent>
      </Card>
    </div>
  );
}
```

"use client";

import { UserButton } from "@clerk/nextjs";
import Link from "next/link";
import { usePathname } from "next/navigation";
import { Card } from "@buzztrip/components";
import { Badge } from "@buzztrip/components/ui";

export function AdminLayout({ children }: { children: React.ReactNode }) {
  const pathname = usePathname();

  const navigation = [
    { name: "Dashboard", href: "/", current: pathname === "/" },
    { name: "Users", href: "/users", current: pathname === "/users" },
    { name: "Maps", href: "/maps", current: pathname === "/maps" },
    { name: "Analytics", href: "/analytics", current: pathname === "/analytics" },
  ];

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-gray-50">
      {/* Navigation Header */}
      <header className="bg-white shadow-sm border-b">
        <div className="container mx-auto px-6 py-4">
          <div className="flex justify-between items-center">
            <div className="flex items-center space-x-8">
              <div className="flex items-center space-x-2">
                <h1 className="text-xl font-bold">BuzzTrip Admin</h1>
                <Badge variant="secondary">Beta</Badge>
              </div>
              <nav className="flex space-x-6">
                {navigation.map((item) => (
                  <Link
                    key={item.name}
                    href={item.href}
                    className={`px-3 py-2 text-sm font-medium rounded-md transition-colors ${
                      item.current
                        ? "bg-blue-100 text-blue-700"
                        : "text-gray-600 hover:text-gray-900 hover:bg-gray-100"
                    }`}
                  >
                    {item.name}
                  </Link>
                ))}
              </nav>
            </div>
            <div className="flex items-center space-x-4">
              <UserButton
                appearance={{
                  elements: {
                    avatarBox: "w-8 h-8"
                  }
                }}
              />
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </header>

      {/* Main Content */}
      <main className="container mx-auto p-6">
        {children}
      </main>

      {/* Footer */}
      <footer className="bg-white border-t mt-12">
        <div className="container mx-auto px-6 py-4">
          <div className="text-center text-sm text-gray-500">
            BuzzTrip Admin Portal - {new Date().getFullYear()}
          </div>
        </div>
      </footer>
    </div>
  );
}

## Phase 2 Complete: Authentication & Security Infrastructure ✅

I have successfully completed Phase 2 of the BuzzTrip Admin Portal development! Here's a comprehensive summary of what was implemented:

### ✅ **Admin Role Verification System**
- **Metadata-based Authentication**: Implemented proper Clerk role verification using `publicMetadata.role`
- **TypeScript Types**: Created global type definitions for `Roles` and `CustomJwtSessionClaims`
- **Helper Functions**: Built reusable utility functions (`checkRole`, `isAdmin`, `requireAdmin`, `isAdminUser`)
- **Fallback Authentication**: Email-based admin check for initial setup before roles are configured

### ✅ **Robust Middleware & Security**
- **Enhanced Middleware**: Updated `/middleware.ts` with proper role-based protection
- **Error Handling**: Comprehensive try-catch blocks with proper error logging
- **Security Logging**: Admin access attempts are logged for security monitoring
- **Redirect Handling**: Proper redirect URLs for better UX during authentication
- **Unauthorized Page**: Created dedicated `/unauthorized` page for non-admin users

### ✅ **Admin-Specific Convex Queries**
- **Analytics Queries**: Comprehensive admin queries in `/packages/backend/convex/admin.ts`:
  - `getUserStats()` - User growth, registration trends, activity metrics
  - `getMapStats()` - Maps, collaboration patterns, content metrics
  - `getActivityMetrics()` - User engagement, feature adoption, session data
  - `getGlobalStats()` - Places, reviews, photos aggregation
  - `getDashboardOverview()` - Combined metrics for dashboard view

### ✅ **User Management with Clerk Admin SDK**
- **Server Actions**: Complete user management system in `/app/actions/user-management.ts`:
  - `getUsers()` - Paginated user listing with search
  - `updateUserRole()` - Role assignment functionality
  - `toggleUserBan()` - Ban/unban user capabilities
  - `deleteUser()` - User deletion with proper security
  - `searchUsers()` - Search by email and name

```typescript
import posthog from 'posthog-js';

// PostHog configuration
const POSTHOG_KEY = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_POSTHOG_KEY;
const POSTHOG_HOST = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_POSTHOG_HOST || 'https://us.i.posthog.com';

// Check if PostHog should be enabled
const isPostHogEnabled = !!(POSTHOG_KEY && typeof window !== 'undefined');

// Initialize PostHog only if keys are provided
if (isPostHogEnabled) {
  posthog.init(POSTHOG_KEY, {
    api_host: POSTHOG_HOST,
    // Disable in development unless explicitly enabled
    loaded: (posthog) => {
      if (process.env.NODE_ENV === 'development') {
        console.log('PostHog initialized for development');
      }
    },
    capture_pageview: false, // We'll manually capture pageviews
    capture_pageleave: true,
    // Admin-specific configuration
    person_profiles: 'identified_only', // Only track identified admin users
  });
} else {
  console.log('PostHog not initialized - missing NEXT_PUBLIC_POSTHOG_KEY or running server-side');
}

// Safe PostHog wrapper that doesn't break when PostHog is not available
export const analytics = {
  // Track events with admin context
  track: (event: string, properties?: Record<string, any>) => {
    if (isPostHogEnabled) {
      posthog.capture(event, {
        ...properties,
        $groups: { admin_portal: 'buzztrip_admin' },
        context: 'admin_portal'
      });
    } else {
      console.log('PostHog Track (dev):', event, properties);
    }
  },

  // Identify admin users
  identify: (userId: string, properties?: Record<string, any>) => {
    if (isPostHogEnabled) {
      posthog.identify(userId, {
        ...properties,
        role: 'admin',
        portal: 'admin'
      });
    } else {
      console.log('PostHog Identify (dev):', userId, properties);
    }
  },

  // Track page views manually
  pageview: (path?: string) => {
    if (isPostHogEnabled) {
      posthog.capture('$pageview', {
        $current_url: path || window.location.href,
        context: 'admin_portal'
      });
    } else {
      console.log('PostHog Pageview (dev):', path || window.location.href);
    }
  },

  // Group admin users for analytics
  group: (groupType: string, groupKey: string, properties?: Record<string, any>) => {
    if (isPostHogEnabled) {
      posthog.group(groupType, groupKey, properties);
    } else {
      console.log('PostHog Group (dev):', groupType, groupKey, properties);
    }
  },

  // Reset user session
  reset: () => {
    if (isPostHogEnabled) {
      posthog.reset();
    } else {
      console.log('PostHog Reset (dev)');
    }
  },

  // Check if PostHog is available
  isEnabled: () => isPostHogEnabled,

  // Get the raw PostHog instance (only when enabled)
  getInstance: () => isPostHogEnabled ? posthog : null,
};

// Admin-specific event types
export const AdminEvents = {
  // Authentication events
  ADMIN_LOGIN: 'admin_login',
  ADMIN_LOGOUT: 'admin_logout',
  ADMIN_ACCESS_DENIED: 'admin_access_denied',

  // Dashboard events
  DASHBOARD_VIEWED: 'admin_dashboard_viewed',
  METRICS_REFRESHED: 'admin_metrics_refreshed',

  // User management events
  USER_ROLE_UPDATED: 'admin_user_role_updated',
  USER_BANNED: 'admin_user_banned',
  USER_UNBANNED: 'admin_user_unbanned',
  USER_DELETED: 'admin_user_deleted',
  USER_SEARCHED: 'admin_user_searched',
  USERS_EXPORTED: 'admin_users_exported',

  // Navigation events
  PAGE_VIEWED: 'admin_page_viewed',
  FEATURE_USED: 'admin_feature_used',

  // System events
  ERROR_OCCURRED: 'admin_error_occurred',
  PERFORMANCE_MEASURED: 'admin_performance_measured',
} as const;

// Helper function to track admin actions with consistent properties
export const trackAdminAction = (
  event: string,
  properties?: Record<string, any>,
  userInfo?: { userId?: string; email?: string; role?: string }
) => {
  analytics.track(event, {
    ...properties,
    timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
    user_id: userInfo?.userId,
    user_email: userInfo?.email,
    user_role: userInfo?.role || 'admin',
    admin_portal_version: '1.0.0',
  });
};

// Helper function to track page views with admin context
export const trackAdminPageView = (page: string, additionalProperties?: Record<string, any>) => {
  analytics.track(AdminEvents.PAGE_VIEWED, {
    page,
    url: typeof window !== 'undefined' ? window.location.href : '',
    ...additionalProperties,
  });
};

export default analytics;
```

   196→      firstName: user.firstName,

Now let me create a React hook to handle admin user identification for better PostHog enrichment. This will automatically identify admin users when they access the portal:

_**Agent (claude-sonnet-4-20250514)**_

Tool use: **Write**

```typescript
"use client";

import { useUser } from "@clerk/nextjs";
import { useEffect } from "react";
import { analytics } from "@/lib/posthog";

/**
 * Hook to initialize admin analytics and identify the current admin user
 */
export function useAdminAnalytics() {
  const { user } = useUser();

  useEffect(() => {
    if (user) {
      // Identify the admin user in PostHog
      analytics.identify(user.id, {
        email: user.emailAddresses[0]?.emailAddress,
        firstName: user.firstName,
        lastName: user.lastName,
        role: user.publicMetadata?.role || 'admin',
        createdAt: user.createdAt,
        lastSignInAt: user.lastSignInAt,
        imageUrl: user.imageUrl,
      });

      // Set up admin group
      analytics.group('admin_portal', 'buzztrip_admin', {
        portal_type: 'admin',
        organization: 'BuzzTrip',
        environment: process.env.NODE_ENV,
      });
    }
  }, [user]);

  return {
    user,
    isEnabled: analytics.isEnabled(),
    track: analytics.track,
    pageview: analytics.pageview,
    identify: analytics.identify,
    group: analytics.group,
    reset: analytics.reset,
  };
}
```

6. **Automatic User Identification** (`src/hooks/use-admin-analytics.ts`):
   - Automatically identifies admin users when they access the portal
   - Enriches user profiles with Clerk metadata
   - Sets up admin portal grouping for analytics

7. **Global Page Tracking** (`src/components/admin-layout.tsx:19-26`):
   - Tracks all page navigation within the admin portal

You have **two options** to gain admin access:

```
## Metadata in the session token

Retrieving metadata from the `User` object on the server-side requires making an API request to Clerk's Backend API, which is slower and is subject to [rate limits](https://clerk.com/docs/guides/how-clerk-works/system-limits#backend-api-requests). You can store it in the user's session token, which doesn't require making an API request as it's available on the user's authentication context. **However, there is a size limitation to keep in mind.** Clerk stores the session token in a cookie, and most browsers cap cookie size at [**4KB**⁠](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc2109#section-6.3). After accounting for the size of Clerk's default claims, the cookie can support **up to 1.2KB** of custom claims. **Exceeding this limit will cause the cookie to not be set, which will break your app as Clerk depends on cookies to work properly.**

If you need to store more than 1.2KB of metadata, you should [store the extra data in your own database](https://clerk.com/docs/guides/development/webhooks/syncing#storing-extra-user-data) instead. If this isn't an option, you can [move particularly large claims out of the token](https://clerk.com/docs/guides/sessions/session-tokens#example) and fetch them using a separate API call from your backend, but this approach brings back the issue of making an API request to Clerk's Backend API, which is slower and is subject to rate limits.

Another limitation of storing metadata in the session token is that when you modify metadata server-side, the changes won't appear in the session token until the next refresh. To avoid race conditions, either [force a JWT refresh](https://clerk.com/docs/guides/sessions/force-token-refresh) after metadata changes or handle the delay in your application logic.

If you've considered the limitations, and you still want to store metadata in the session token:

1.  In the Clerk Dashboard, navigate to the [**Sessions**⁠](https://dashboard.clerk.com/last-active?path=sessions) page.
2.  Under **Customize session token**, in the **Claims** editor, you can add any claim to your session token that you need and select **Save**. To avoid exceeding the session token's 1.2KB limit, it's not recommended to add the entire `user.public_metadata` object. Instead, add individual fields as claims, like `user.public_metadata.birthday`. When doing this, it's recommended to leave particularly large claims out of the token to avoid exceeding the session token's size limit. See the [example](https://clerk.com/docs/guides/sessions/session-tokens#example) for more information.

## Add custom claims to your session token

[Session tokens](https://clerk.com/docs/guides/sessions/session-tokens) are JWTs that are generated by Clerk on behalf of your instance, and contain claims that allow you to store data about a user's session. With Clerk, when a session token exists for a user, it indicates that the user is authenticated, and the associated claims can be retrieved at any time.

For this guide, you will use an `onboardingComplete` property in the user's public metadata to track their onboarding status. But first, you need to add a custom claim to the session token that will allow you to access the user's public metadata in your Middleware.

To edit the session token:

1.  In the Clerk Dashboard, navigate to the [**Sessions**⁠](https://dashboard.clerk.com/last-active?path=sessions) page.
    
2.  Under **Customize session token**, in the **Claims** editor, add any claim you need to your session token. For this guide, add the following:
    
    \```
    {
    "metadata":"{{user.public_metadata}}"
    }
    \```
    
3.  Select **Save**.
    
To get auto-complete and prevent TypeScript errors when working with custom session claims, you can define a global type.

1.  In your application's root folder, add a `types` directory.
2.  Inside of the `types` directory, add a `globals.d.ts` file.
3.  Create the `CustomJwtSessionClaims` interface and declare it globally.
4.  Add the custom claims to the `CustomJwtSessionClaims` interface.

For this guide, your `globals.d.ts` file should look like this:

types/globals.d.ts

\```
export {}

declare global {
interfaceCustomJwtSessionClaims {
    metadata: {
      onboardingComplete?:boolean
    }
  }
}
\```
```
